statusLine.command: input=$(cat); hostname=$(hostname -s); cwd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir'); session=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.session_name // empty'); remaining=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.remaining_percentage // empty'); short_dir=$(echo "$cwd" | awk -F'/' '{n=NF; if(n<=3) print $0; else printf ".../%s/%s/%s",$(n-2),$(n-1),$n}'); short_dir="${short_dir/#$HOME/~}"; branch=$(git -C "$cwd" --no-optional-locks branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || git -C "$cwd" --no-optional-locks rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null); git_info=""; [ -n "$branch" ] && git_info=$(printf "\033[1;36m‹%s› \033[0m" "$branch"); context=""; [ -n "$remaining" ] && context=$(printf "\033[2m[%s%% remain] \033[0m" "$remaining"); sess=""; [ -n "$session" ] && sess=$(printf "\033[2m[%s] \033[0m" "$session"); printf "%s\033[1;35m :: \033[0m\033[32m%s\033[0m %s%s%s" "$hostname" "$short_dir" "$git_info" "$sess" "$context"
